form:FormGroup.label: Meta Data
form:FormGroup.helpText: Extra meta data to attach to the uploaded data, one 'Key:Value' entry per line. Example: System:Example.

form:FormGroup.label: Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: The stream type to give the uploaded data, for example Raw Events or Raw Reference. Defaults to the feed's stream type.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Stream type for the uploaded data. Defaults to the feed's type.

form:FormGroup.label: Effective Date
form:FormGroup.helpText: The date and time from which the data applies, mainly for reference data. Optional. Use ISO 8601 format; add Z for UTC, for example 2026-01-31T00:00:00.000Z.

form:FormGroup.label: File
form:FormGroup.helpText: The file to upload. A .zip file is unpacked as a Stroom zip; .gz and .gzip files are treated as gzip compressed. Other files are stored as they are.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: .zip and .gz files are handled as compressed data.
